notes: Full-layer chart carried blanket 'Skill' rows disagreeing with content win[] and the packet chart (Xerath L1 through L6, Ahri from first item); content win[] already matched the packet so side edits move full to agree — no win[] edits needed. phases[4] side was 'Ahri' at Level 6 while its own why described Xerath sniping; flipped to Xerath per packet+content+whys[4]. Ratings left untouched: their semantics (owner-favor vs intensity) are not documented and guessing risked corrupting seven rows — flagging for a rubric. Charm cancelling Xerath's R channel (missingInteractions) is real (Riot text: 'instantly stopping movement abilities' plus hardCC; Xerath R is an interruptible channel) but report[5] is not lint-flagged and the sweep excludes report[]; surfacing here instead: channel R only after her E is down. Ahri Q return true damage means MR stacking is a weak answer; Essence Theft makes antiheal relevant in long chip wars — neither is on the page, both left unwritten rather than squeezed into length bands. sectionsMissing: breakdown.carry, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.late, enemyWin remain structurally templated but no Ahri-specific grounded replacement fit the length band without inventing magnitudes.
